* This card can be sent from the Extra Deck directly to the Graveyard with cards like "[[Nekroz Kaleidoscope]]", "[[Extra-Foolish Burial]]", "[[Zaborg the Mega Monarch]]", "[[Gale Dogra]]", "[[Dogmatika Punishment]]", "[[Ultimate Slayer]]" etc. in order to use its second effect.
